macros.name: annotationheadings
macros.doc: The \annotationheadings macro is automatically called every time a new annotation environment is created. By default, it simply calls \poetryheadings, but it can be redefined to give your annotation pages a different heading style than your poem pages.

macros.name: dedicationformat
macros.doc: Redefine \dedicationformat to change how the dedication text is formatted.

macros.name: linktopoem
macros.doc: We can link to poems easily enough by providing linktopoem with the text for the link and, optionally, the number of the poem to link to.

macros.name: listofpoems
macros.doc: The \listofpoems command is nothing more than a convenient alias for \listofpoem as defined by the tocloft package.

macros.name: makededication
macros.doc: To create a dedication page, the \makededication command can be called.

macros.name: nonumberpoems
macros.doc: This command determines if the poems should display their number above the title.

macros.name: numberpoems
macros.doc: This command determines if the poems should display their number above the title.

macros.name: poemgroup
macros.doc: Dividing poems up into groups can be accomplished with the \poemgroup command. The command creates a title-page for the group at the current location and adds entries to the ToP and ToC unless the starred version of the command is used.

macros.name: poemtitleformat
macros.doc: By redefining \poemtitleformat we can change how the poem title is rendered.

macros.name: ptannotationenv
macros.doc: This contains the name of the default environment in which we should wrap annotations.

macros.name: ptgap
macros.doc: Redefine \ptgap to change the length that \ptind indents by.

macros.name: ptgroup
macros.doc: The \ptgroup command will always contain a reference to the current group in case you need to refer to it later.

macros.name: ptspacerchar
macros.doc: The ptspacergap length is the indentation of the spacer, and \ptspacerchar is the actual character that will be printed ptspacernum times.

macros.name: resetnumon
macros.doc: We can reset poem numbering at a given point by redefining the \resetnumon macro.

macros.name: setpoemgroup
macros.doc: If you want to change the group, but don’t want to create a title page, use the \setpoemgroup command.

macros.name: stanzaparskip
macros.doc: This length is used to change the parskip within a poem environment.

macros.name: theincipit
macros.doc: After an incipit has been declared, this will expand to the text of the incipit for the current poem.

macros.name: topname
macros.doc: The value of \topname will be rendered atop the Table of Poems, and \topentrytype will set the default entry type for poems in the ToP.

macros.name: toptocentrytype
macros.doc: \toptocentrytype sets the default entry type for the ToP in the ToC.

macros.name: usedefaulttitles
macros.doc: If \usedefaulttitles is called the default title will be displayed above the poem itself as well as in the table of contents.
